post.description:
Password recovery: emails a 5-digit code (valid 15 minutes) that ``POST /auth/reset-password`` takes with the
email address. Always answers 200 with the same body: whether or not the email belongs to an account (so it cannot
be used to find out who is registered), whether or not this address is over its hourly limit (3 emails an hour; the
rest are answered the same and logged), and whether or not the mail could be delivered (a failure is logged). The
mail goes out after the reply, so the response time does not depend on the mail server. A new request makes the
previous code useless.

schema.title: Response Recover Password Api V1 Auth Password Recovery Post

post.description:
Reset the password with the emailed code: ``{email, code, new_password}``. The new password must pass the same
policy as change-password. Success ends every session of the account (the app signs in again with the new
password; no tokens are returned). 400 ``detail = {"code", "message"}`` for ``invalid_or_expired_code`` (wrong,
expired, used, never issued, or no such account: one answer) and ``weak_password`` (the code is not consumed);
429 ``too_many_attempts`` after 5 wrong codes for the address, until a new code is requested.

Deprecated: ``{token, new_password}`` with the long token from the same email still works for the shipped caregiver
app, with plain-string ``detail`` errors (400 ``Invalid token`` / ``Invalid or expired token`` / the weak-password
sentence).

post.description:

signed out); the response carries a new pair, so the caller stays signed in. 400 with
``detail = {"code", "message"}`` for ``wrong_current_password``, ``weak_password`` and ``same_password``;
429 ``too_many_attempts`` (with Retry-After) after repeated wrong current passwords.

Free before a caregiver is assigned or more than 12 hours before the visit; 20% of the service fee from 12 to 2 hours

post.description:
Cancel a booking while it is dispatching, accepted or on the way.

Never moves money by itself: a paid booking gets a refund (paid minus the fee) that a person approves, sent back to the
original payment method. Idempotent: repeating a cancel the booker already made returns the same result with
``already_cancelled`` true, with no second fee or refund. Cancelled for any other reason, or started, completed or
closed: 409 with a stable ``detail.code``.

post.summary: Get the payment link of a booking that is not paid yet (booker only)
post.description:
The "Pay now" link for a booking created earlier, so it survives an app restart.

Same response as ``/create`` (the booking with ``payment_url`` and ``payment_access_code``) plus ``paystack_reference``
and ``payment_expires_at``. The link is the one Paystack gave when the booking was created (stored on the booking). The
booking keeps its one Paystack reference, so Paystack itself can charge it only once: tapping twice, or paying on an old page and a new
one, can never charge twice. Paystack is asked first whether the booking was already paid (a late webhook): if so it
is settled and the answer is 409 ``booking_already_paid``. Nothing is written when a link is handed out. Only for a
pending booking whose payment window is still open; the window is not extended.

**channels** (optional, ``["card"]``, ``["bank_transfer"]`` or both) limits Paystack's checkout page. It only applies
when the server has to make a new link (a booking with no stored link). A booking that already has its link, which is
every booking made through ``/create``, gets that same link back whatever this request names: the first link wins.
The person's method is chosen on ``/create``. The body can be left out entirely; no amount or other field is accepted.

schema.description: Optional. Send nothing, or {"channels": [...]}; see the note on channels below.

post.description: Approve every payout still waiting in the batch. The send job then pays them through Paystack.
Cancel a batch that has not been approved: every payout in it is cancelled and its money returned.
Cancel a payout that has not been approved; the reserved money goes back to the caregiver's available balance.
Send a failed or reversed payout again (the money is reserved again; the send job pays it).

Settle a payout Paystack's own word has not (``processing``, for example stuck at OTP, or ``needs_attention``) as
``paid`` or ``failed`` (the reserved money is returned). Paystack is asked first; an answer that contradicts the outcome
refuses it, and an answer that is not final needs ``force: true``.

Let a caregiver whose payouts were frozen be paid again. Refused while any of their payouts still needs attention or is
processing. A shortfall is first debited from the caregiver's available balance; what the balance cannot cover refuses the
unfreeze (409) unless ``write_off_shortfall`` is true.

post.description: Raise a refund by hand (a complaint, or anything else). It waits for someone else to approve it.
Approve a pending refund. Above the Finance limit, or to the wallet, a Super Admin is needed.
Reject a pending refund; it is finished and the booking can be refunded again.
Send a failed refund again, once Paystack confirms the last attempt failed.
Give Paystack the family's bank account for a refund that needs it. The account number is never stored.
Pay a failed refund to the patient's Oakly wallet instead (Super Admin).
Give up on a failed refund: the money stays with Oakly and the booking can be refunded again.
Settle a refund in review as succeeded or failed after checking the Paystack dashboard (Super Admin).

plan_version.title: Plan Version
plan_version.description: The plan's version after this write; use it as the next expected_version.

category.title: Category
category.description: `special_note` shows under Allergies and Special Instructions; `observation` under Notes.

next_before.title: Next Before
next_before.description: Pass as `before` for the next (older) page; null on the last.

next_before_id.title: Next Before Id
next_before_id.description: Pass as `before_id` together with `before` (it breaks ties between notes with the same timestamp); null on the last.

PasswordReset.title: PasswordReset
PasswordReset.description:
``{email, code, new_password}`` (the emailed 5-digit code) or, deprecated, ``{token, new_password}`` (the long
link token the shipped caregiver app pastes). Exactly one form.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Optional. Which payment methods Paystack's checkout page offers: ["card"], ["bank_transfer"] or both. Left out, Paystack shows its own default channels. Only applied when the payment link is first made: the same booking always keeps the link it was created with.

PaymentLinkRequest.title: PaymentLinkRequest
PaymentLinkRequest.description:
Optional body of ``POST /booking/{id}/payment-link``. The whole body may be left out. Nothing about the money
can be sent: an amount, card details or any other field is a 422, not silently ignored.

dispatch_state.title: Dispatch State
dispatch_state.description: dispatching | matched | unmatched; null before payment or for legacy bookings

arrived_at.title: Arrived At
arrived_at.description: When the assigned caregiver tapped "I've arrived" (UTC); null until then. The status does not change: the visit still starts with the visit code.

caregiver_earning.title: Caregiver Earning
caregiver_earning.description: Naira the assigned caregiver earns for completing this visit (their share of the service fee, from the terms copied onto the booking when it was created). Caregiver views only, for an accepted, en route, in progress or completed booking; null for everyone else and when the booking carries no snapshot.

visit_code.title: Visit Code
visit_code.description: 4-digit code the patient gives the caregiver to start the visit. Only returned to the booking's own patient from GET /booking/booking/{id}, while the booking is accepted or en_route; null for everyone else and in every other response.

cancel_fee_tier.title: Cancel Fee Tier
cancel_fee_tier.description: Which cancellation fee applied when the booker cancelled (none = free). Null while the booking is not cancelled by its booker, and always null for caregivers.

cancel_fee.title: Cancel Fee
cancel_fee.description: Naira the booker was charged for cancelling (0 for a free cancel). Null unless the booker cancelled; patient views only.

refund.description: The booking's refund, newest one, when it has one. Patient views only; null for caregivers.

payment_url.title: Payment Url
payment_url.description: Paystack payment URL to complete the booking payment

payment_access_code.title: Payment Access Code
payment_access_code.description: Paystack access code for the payment

payment_error.title: Payment Error
payment_error.description: Error message if payment initialization failed

paystack_reference.title: Paystack Reference
paystack_reference.description: The booking's one Paystack reference (the same for every link)

payment_expires_at.title: Payment Expires At
payment_expires_at.description: When the unpaid booking is cancelled if it is still not paid (UTC)

PaymentLinkResponse.title: PaymentLinkResponse
PaymentLinkResponse.description: ``POST /booking/{id}/payment-link``: what ``/create`` returns, plus the reference and when the window closes.

batch_period.title: Batch Period
batch_period.description: The payout day of the batch (an ISO date)

account_number.title: Account Number
account_number.description: Masked to the last four digits

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Our unique Paystack reference for the current attempt

transfer_code.title: Transfer Code
transfer_code.description: Paystack's code once the transfer exists

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: The number of the current attempt

attempt_history.title: Attempt History
attempt_history.description: Every send of this payout, oldest first, with its failure reason

shortfall_kobo.title: Shortfall Kobo
shortfall_kobo.description: Paid out by Paystack but not recoverable from the caregiver's balance. Goes down only when an admin nets it off (resolve as failed), or at unfreeze, when it is debited from the caregiver's balance or written off

returned_kobo.title: Returned Kobo
returned_kobo.description: Set by resolving as failed: how much of the reservation went back to the balance

netted_kobo.title: Netted Kobo
netted_kobo.description: Set by resolving as failed: how much was kept against the caregiver's shortfall

caregiver_payouts_frozen_at.title: Caregiver Payouts Frozen At
caregiver_payouts_frozen_at.description: The caregiver-level freeze (the same on every payout of the caregiver); null when they can be paid

failure_reason.title: Failure Reason
failure_reason.description: Why it failed, or a note that needs a person (for example the OTP message)

initiated_at.title: Initiated At
initiated_at.description: When the send job claimed it to call Paystack; null until then

cancelled_by.title: Cancelled By
cancelled_by.description: Null when the system cancelled it at approval

force.title: Force
force.description: Resolve although Paystack's answer is not final (pending, OTP, no record, unreachable). Never overrides a definite answer that contradicts the outcome.

write_off_shortfall.title: Write Off Shortfall
write_off_shortfall.description: Write off the shortfall that the caregiver's available balance cannot cover (money Paystack paid beyond their earnings). The balance is debited first; without this flag a shortfall that is left refuses the unfreeze (409).

overall_percent.title: Overall Percent
overall_percent.description: Ticked / scheduled task occurrences over visit days only; null when there is nothing to measure yet.

day.title: Day
day.description: Day number of the plan, 0 before it starts, never above `of_days`.

by_day.title: By Day
by_day.description: The last 14 visit days, oldest first.

amount_naira.title: Amount Naira
amount_naira.description: Omit to approve the suggested amount

account_number.title: Account Number
account_number.description: Sent to Paystack and never stored

max_approvable_naira.title: Max Approvable Naira
max_approvable_naira.description: The most this caller may approve: what is left to refund and, without refunds.approve_above_limit, what is left under the Finance limit

take_back_preview_naira.title: Take Back Preview Naira
take_back_preview_naira.description: What taking the caregiver's share back would be at this refund's amount; null once the refund is finished

needs_super_admin.title: Needs Super Admin
needs_super_admin.description: This refund's amount is more than this caller may approve (see max_approvable_naira)

max_approvable_naira.title: Max Approvable Naira
max_approvable_naira.description: The most this caller may approve: what is left to refund and, without refunds.approve_above_limit, what is left under the Finance limit

amount_naira.title: Amount Naira
amount_naira.description: Only to record a different amount than the refund's, when Paystack processed that amount (the 409 names it)

status.title: Status
status.description: under_review: waiting for a person to approve it. processing: approved and on its way (also while Finance retries a failed attempt). needs_bank_details: the bank asked for the family's account; support will ask for it. refunded: money sent. declined: not refunded. contact_support: closed without a payout; support follows up.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Naira that will be (or was) refunded; null while a person still has to decide the amount

priced.title: Priced
priced.description: Does the newest pricing have a multiplier for it? A service can only be enabled when true

bookable.title: Bookable
bookable.description: enabled AND priced: what patients are offered

ServiceCatalogWrite.title: ServiceCatalogWrite
ServiceCatalogWrite.description: The full editable state of one service (PUT replaces it: sending the same body twice changes nothing).

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Which table `id` is in: `patient` (patients) or `recipient` (care_recipients). Send it back as `patient_id` or `care_recipient_id` respectively.

can_tick.title: Can Tick
can_tick.description: Today, the plan is active, and the caller has a visit for this client in progress.

slots.title: Slots
slots.description: Only slots that have a task that day, in day order.

time_of_day.title: Time Of Day
time_of_day.description: Display time, HH:MM. null clears it.

TaskPatch.title: TaskPatch
TaskPatch.description:
Only the fields sent change. ``time_of_day`` accepts null to clear it. Editing the days or the slot applies to every
day, including days already past (the plan keeps one definition of a task).

plan_version.title: Plan Version
plan_version.description: The plan's version after this write; use it as the next expected_version.

clinical_review_status.title: Clinical Review Status
clinical_review_status.description: While pending, show 'Not yet clinically reviewed'.

clinical_review_status.title: Clinical Review Status
clinical_review_status.description: While pending, show 'Not yet clinically reviewed'.

status.title: Status
status.description: `approved` after a clinician has read the content; `pending` takes the approval back. Either way the reviewer and time are recorded and the call is audited.

payouts_frozen_at.title: Payouts Frozen At
payouts_frozen_at.description: Null: the caregiver can be paid again

debited_from_balance_kobo.title: Debited From Balance Kobo
debited_from_balance_kobo.description: Taken from the caregiver's available balance against the shortfall

outstanding_shortfall_kobo.title: Outstanding Shortfall Kobo
outstanding_shortfall_kobo.description: Shortfall still recorded on the caregiver's payouts (always 0: what the balance cannot cover is written off or the unfreeze is refused)

subject_ready.title: Subject Ready
subject_ready.description: false: an app booking for someone else, so there is no identifiable client and no care plan is possible.

can_author.title: Can Author
can_author.description: A nurse, and a client who can have a plan.

plan.description: The client's active plan; null if there is none yet.

VoiceNoteErrorBody.title: VoiceNoteErrorBody
VoiceNoteErrorBody.description: The shape of every error of these routes: ``{"detail": {"code", "message"}}``.

VoiceNoteReadOut.title: VoiceNoteReadOut
VoiceNoteReadOut.description: A saved note as the rest of the care team sees it: no error, expiry or consent fields.

account_last4.title: Account Last4
account_last4.description: The last 4 digits only; the full number is never stored
